purpose: Implementation guards specific to new analytic envelopes; not proof by Monte Carlo
scope: At most8 deterministic tiny synthetic controls after separate authorization

controls.requirement: Tiny rational fixed Gaussian geometry, supported full-rank X; verify RX=0, RCRt=I and pointwise base inequality; no reused integral test
Curved mean family entirely inside prescribed V; verify distance relaxation and gain bound with deterministic vectors
Nonlinear curve with one-dimensional tangent but larger affine span; reject tangent-only certificate
Negative/zero gain maps to p1; rank-zero pivot handled as atom0; no scipy df0 call
Fabricated local residual upper value must not be accepted as lower bound; Lnull-Ucomp ordering required
Analytic epsilon covariance counterexample must block reuse of RSS-based likelihood envelope
Missing scenario leaves robust unavailable, but another complete valid rejection survives; no silent best-case selection
Integer/half-integer SF recurrences compared with certified enclosures, no underflow-zero or unbudgeted certificate failure

failure_policy: Visible terminal failure, no repeated uncertain unit and no covariance/model repair
